## Paper

College Admissions and the Stability of Marriage

## World

labor_market

## Institution

Deferred-acceptance matching.

## Agent type

Workers/students and employers/colleges with preferences.

## Theoretical benchmark

Deferred acceptance produces stable matchings with no blocking pairs under truthful preferences.

## Learning setup

Workers report top choices or rankings; employers have fixed preferences; matching is computed by deferred acceptance.

## Metrics

Match rate, stability, blocking pairs, welfare, truthful-report rate, manipulation diagnostics.

## Main result

A stable matching always exists and can be found through the deferred acceptance procedure. The procedure is optimal for the proposing side and results in a stable set of marriages.

## What they prove

There always exists a stable set of marriages; the deferred acceptance procedure finds a stable matching; the procedure is optimal for the proposing side

## What they only simulate

Not applicable for this card's thesis use: it is treated as a theorem/procedure anchor for stable matching, not as simulation evidence.

## What they do NOT test

Learning agents, repeated report adaptation, welfare comparisons across learned policies, and neural/MARL matching behavior are outside this paper's original theory role.

## What we need to reproduce

Verify matching validity and blocking-pair stability before interpreting learned reports.

## How our project differs

The paper gives matching theory. This repo lets learning agents report preferences and measures whether outcomes stay stable.

## Implementation obligations

Valid matching; no duplicate assignments; blocking-pair detection; side-proposing semantics; truthful benchmark cases.

## Metrics to compare in our repo

worlds/labor_market/benchmarks.py; outputs/labor_market_full stability metrics.

## Failure modes to audit

Full match rate mistaken for stability; no blocking-pair check; side-proposing mechanism unspecified; asymmetric agents forced into symmetric MARL assumptions.

## Project code comparison

Compare College Admissions and the Stability of Marriage to Labor Market benchmark cases and full outputs. Stability, not just match rate, is the theory obligation.
